label: EXPLORATORY - Experiment K (not confirmatory; conditional on the fitted systems)
calibration_scope: simulate_days draws outputs i.i.d. given (user, target) within a day, with no within-day drift and no sequential dependence. calibrate_effect fits (shrink, drift_sd) by least squares to the source's undefended Bayes N-way BA of the categorical attackers (cat_blind, cat_aware) within-day and cross-day. For K's Lee2019 source the fitted model reproduces the cross-day targets but underfits within-day identification at small k (power_calibration_fit.csv). The power function is therefore calibrated for cross-day statistics with categorical attackers - M's candidates cal_to_dep and dep_to_dep are both cross-day; the Markov attackers in the simulated candidate set see no sequential structure, and within-day statistics at small k would be understated.
